placement_enumeration.base_bounds: all 40 um multiples from negative to positive full geometry depth span inclusive
placement_enumeration.geometric_prefilter: for every base+state total shift, at least one exact same-column source-to-target mapping must exist
placement_enumeration.candidate_choice: first passing base in the frozen order

native_clone_gate.comparison_bank: all 90 measured candidate templates at native position, restricted to the actual 182-channel target

cohort_rule.if_more_than_30: take five from each of six equal target-depth strata, then globally fill any empty quota
within_stratum_rank: ascending raw adjacent ISI under 1 ms fraction
